sql:
CREATE VIEW timetz_local_view AS
  SELECT f1 AS dat,
       f1 AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TimeZone') AS dat_at_tz,
       f1 AT TIME ZONE INTERVAL '00:00' AS dat_at_int
  FROM TIMETZ_TBL
  ORDER BY f1
shape: CREATE VIEW timetz_local_view AS SELECT f1 AS dat, f1 AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TimeZone') AS dat_at_tz, f1 AT TIME ZONE INTERVAL '00:00' AS dat_at_int FROM TIMETZ_TBL ORDER BY f1;

sql:
SELECT f1 AS dat,
       f1 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC+10' AS dat_at_tz,
       f1 AT TIME ZONE INTERVAL '-10:00' AS dat_at_int
  FROM TIMETZ_TBL
  ORDER BY f1
